query:

  LEFT(coreCapabilities, 100) as caps,
  LEFT(valuePropositions, 100) as vps,
  LEFT(icpIndustries, 100) as industries,
  LEFT(icpPainPoints, 100) as painPoints,
  LEFT(icpBuyingSignals, 100) as buyingSignals,
  LEFT(fitCriteria, 100) as fitCriteria,
  LEFT(urgencyTriggers, 100) as urgencyTriggers,
  status
FROM offering_brain WHERE id = 210002;
